drums.tags: Lo-fi hip hop. A dusty, vinyl-crackling drum break features a muffled kick and a crisp, slightly swung snare. A Rhodes electric piano plays a repeating four-bar progression of jazz-influenced seventh chords with a soft tremolo effect. A deep, rounded electric bass follows the root notes of the piano with a laid-back, behind-the-beat feel. A subtle, high-pitched sine wave synth melody enters periodically with heavy portamento. The track maintains a steady 85 BPM in the key of C minor. High-frequency hiss and occasional vinyl pops are layered throughout the mix. The arrangement is minimalist, focusing on the interplay between the Rhodes and the drum loop.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[vinyl crackle and hiss, muffled drum break enters]

[Main Theme]
[Rhodes electric piano playing jazz chords, electric bass enters]

[Bridge]
[sine wave synth with portamento melody, drums continue with swung snare]

[Outro]
[bass and synth fade out, Rhodes piano and vinyl crackle remain until silence]

bass.tags: Industrial techno with heavy EBM influences. A distorted, overdriven kick drum drives the rhythm at 130 BPM in 4/4 time. A resonant, syncopated synth bassline follows a 16th-note pattern with high-pass filter automation. Metallic percussion hits and white noise snares occur on the backbeat. A high-pitched, dissonant lead synth enters with a short decay and heavy delay, playing a repetitive three-note motif. Industrial sound effects, including mechanical clangs and bit-crushed textures, are layered throughout the arrangement. The track maintains a consistent high-energy density with minimal melodic variation, focusing on timbral evolution and rhythmic drive. Key of D minor.
bass.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[distorted kick drum, metallic percussion]
[syncopated synth bass enters]

[Main Section]
[high-pitched dissonant synth lead with delay]
[white noise snare hits]
[bit-crushed industrial sound effects]

[Breakdown]
[kick drum drops out, filtered synth bass continues]
[mechanical clanging sounds]

[Outro]
[kick drum re-enters]
[synth lead fades out]
[final distorted kick hit]
